resources.string: DuoDesk: your computer’s mouse and keyboard

Lets the computer you paired in DuoDesk tap, scroll and type on this phone with its mouse and keyboard when wireless debugging isn’t available (for example over Bluetooth). DuoDesk only acts on what that computer sends while you share its cursor; it doesn’t read your screen.
Check that %1$s shows the same code.
Press Pair to pair this device with %1$s. You\'ll check that both show the same code.

On the USB cable. Click Allow on %1$s.

%1$s uses it for this device\'s screen, its mouse and keyboard here, and sound. Some phones (MIUI, HyperOS) switch it off after a Wi-Fi change, a screen lock or a restart.\n\nSettings opens at Developer options: switch USB debugging and Wireless debugging on, then come back.
Use this device as a screen for %1$s: its own screen (Mirror), or a second one (Extend).
